description: Use when the author explicitly asks to schedule a post to a connected channel or group. Supply an exact ISO date with UTC offset and an idempotency key. The server uses the shared publishing rules and stores an immutable delivery snapshot.

channelId.description: Owner-bound channel id from list_channels; never invent a recipient.

expectedRevision.description: Current revision from get_post/last mutation. On conflict reread and compare changes; never bypass revision.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable 8-128 character key using letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen. Reuse with identical arguments for the same intended schedule after a lost response.

scheduledAt.description: Exact publication time as ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-29T10:00:00+07:00. Resolve the user time zone before scheduling.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Bangkok; the scheduledAt UTC offset specifies the exact instant.

name: schedule_post
title: Schedule a Telegram publication
